server_description: Search the public web through Web IQ for public, general context, such as how import customs holds or carrier delays usually work and how long customs clearance typically takes. Call it once, last, and only for the part of a question that asks for general public context, with a query in public terms. Never put a customer's name, an order, shipment or account number, a person's name, a carrier, a location or any other private or company detail in the query. Use at most one line from it, labelled "Public context, not company guidance", and cite the page's title, site and URL. It never overrides a company document or the live data. Never use it for current status, company documents or mail. Read-only.
